				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><a href="https://www.ion-club.net/dakhla-oasis-212/">ION CLUB Dakhla Oasis212</a>&#8211; Wingfoil &amp; Kitesurf</h2>
<p data-start="174" data-end="858">At <a href="https://www.ion-club.net/dakhla-oasis-212/"><strong>ION CLUB Oasis212</strong></a>, the main advantage is having several spots in one place: perfectly flat water or choppy conditions, shallow or deep areas, and consistent winds around 20 knots, everything is there. It is considered one of the best spots in Dakhla.<br data-start="419" data-end="422" />Riding here is stress-free, without overcrowding, and with the feeling that you truly have time. Time to learn, to progress, or simply to enjoy long runs without pressure.<br data-start="593" data-end="596" />The wind is steady, with a yearly average of around 27 km/h, blowing side to side-onshore. These are ideal conditions for both kitesurfing and wingfoiling, from beginners to advanced riders.<br data-start="786" data-end="789" /><strong>The center is located directly on the spot within the Oasis212 hotel.</strong></p></div>
